description: Sleep per night over a date range, for trends: bedtime and wake time, duration, sleep score, deep / light / REM / awake minutes, nap minutes, average heart rate, respiration, SpO2, sleep stress, breathing disruptions and Garmin's sleep need, plus average / min / max in `summary`. Nights are keyed by the wake-up date. Defaults to the last 7 nights; at most 31 nights per call (Garmin's limit). For one night in full detail use garmin_get_sleep.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 31 days per call.

name: garmin_get_sleep_summaries
title: Get Garmin sleep summaries
